candidates.description: This feature vector activates on non-English text scripts and international characters.
This feature vector activates strongly on conjunctions, prepositions, and common connective words across Thai, English, and other languages.
This feature vector represents common prepositions, possessive markers, and plural prefixes across Thai, French, and English.
This vector activates on the Thai consonant 'ก' (ko kai) and words containing it.
This vector represents the Thai vowel sign Sara I combined with various consonant or vowel modifier tokens.
This vector represents Thai words, prefixes, and common English tokens frequently associated with the copula verb "to be."
This vector represents common single-letter prefixes, grammatical particles, and high-frequency function characters across various languages and writing systems.
This vector represents character sequences and phonetic sub-tokens associated with Arabic script elements and common proper name prefixes starting with "Ha" or "Al".
This vector activates for mixed subword fragments and multilingual character sequences spanning multiple writing systems.
This vector activates on Hebrew-related terms, traditional titles, and specific Thai script characters.
